paragraphs.text: Sharae of Numbing Depths is an Undine wizard from Eldraine .
Sharae is the leader of the merfolk of Loch Larent. She has golden scales and a split tail.
Sharae's design was based on John Galliano 's Fall/Winter 2009 Ready-to-Wear collection, which featured "ice princess" designs inspired by Eastern European and Balkan folklore.

Sharae and her people were trapped under the frozen surface of the lake when Hylda formed the icy castle of Winter's Home. The merfolk were presumably freed when Hylda's powers waned after she gave up her ice crown.
